name: CISA Cyber Storm Series (I–IX+)
description: U.S. CISA-led biennial national-scale cyber exercise series (Cyber Storm I through IX and beyond) involving federal agencies, critical infrastructure sectors, and international partners. Simulates large-scale coordinated cyber attacks on energy, transportation, water, and communications infrastructure. Tests national incident response coordination, information sharing, and crisis decision-making under novel attack scenarios.
general_score_metric: exercise_outcome_score (composite qualitative/quantitative measures such as response effectiveness, information sharing, time-to-recovery)
reputation: Flagship U.S. national cyber exercise series; foundational for national cyber resilience doctrine
notes: Held biennially since 2006. Each iteration involves hundreds of organizations across government and private sector. After-action reports are publicly available and inform national cybersecurity policy.
